{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Show the number of patients with duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}")

# Check how many times each patient_id appears
patient_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients_list = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1].index.tolist()

# Show the list of patient_ids with duplicates
print(f"Patient IDs with duplicates: {duplicate_patients_list}")

# Also check sample_seq for these patients to confirm re-testing
retest_data = data[data['patient_id'].isin(duplicate_patients_list)]
retest_summary = retest_data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
print(retest_summary)"}
